source_caveats: Tentative award September 2 in bid tab vs August 19 dated motion and agreements. Use signed agreement and motion evidence; retain tentative date separately, no silent correction.
Prior 2024-2026 road range 9047-27966 appears beside current range. Exclude prior range from current award; do not combine or annualize.
Totals line says Minimum Quantity while motion uses maximum amount. Preserve both column amounts; 6694*83=555602 and 20269*83=1682327. Neither represents actual spend.
County portion $5478 is distinct from cooperative total. Do not infer county tonnage by division or call cooperative volume County-only demand.
Funding after December 31, 2026 is contingent on appropriated funds. Record term without claiming guaranteed purchases.
